csv_project_name: AE for As-Needed Environmental Consulting Services
csv_agency: City of Portsmouth Dept of Purchasing
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Portsmouth, Virginia hereinafter called the City invites qualified environmental services engineering firms hereinafter called engineer to provide environmental consulting services on an as needed basis during the contract period. The intention is to hire multiple consultants as part of the RFP. Firms responding to this request shall be experienced in a full range of environmental services, including, but not limited to, performing building surveys for asbestos, lead and other hazardous materials; preparation of abatement plans and specifications; ensuring contractor compliance with applicable regulations for asbestos and lead abatement; conducting Phase I and Phase II site assessments; performing wetlands delineation and wetland mitigation plans; and, assisting with environmental permitting issues.
